GitHub helps companies and organizations succeed by enabling them to build better software, together. We're looking for a Senior Service Delivery Engineer to support our Expert Services team in solving our customers' needs. The ideal candidate will have the aptitude and passion to become a master of GitHub's product capabilities and underlying technologies. We need a high performing engineering consultant to help our customers improve their software delivery. This person will solve challenges with many different technologies and work closely with our customers, as well as GitHub's internal departments

Delivery Readiness

  • Create high-quality, reusable solutions for customers

  • Build solutions such as migrating source code from legacy systems, creating CI/CD pipelines, or automating infrastructure provisioning

  • Experience in Software Development or DevOps

  • In-depth knowledge of the Git version control system

Preferred Qualifications

    • OR Master's Degree in Information Technology (IT), Computer Science, Engineering, or related field AND 5+ years experience

Our teams are dreamers, doers, and pioneers, leading the way in AI, driving humanitarian efforts around the globe, and even sending open source to Mars (and beyond!). At GitHub, our goal is to create the space you need to do your best work. We’re remote-first and offer competitive pay, generous learning and growth opportunities, and excellent benefits to support you, wherever you are—because we know that people flourish when they can work on their own terms.
Join us, and let’s change the world, together.

Equal Employment Opportunity

GitHub is made up of people from a wide variety of backgrounds and lifestyles. We embrace diversity and invite applications from people of all walks of life. title: Senior Cloud Engineer
description:
At Luscii, we're creating space for care by developing and improving digital healthcare applications that make a real difference in people's lives through several applications. From Luscii Thuismeten, which helps healthcare professionals monitor patients remotely, to OMRON Connect, connecting millions of people with their health data through OMRON devices, and other applications that expand the possibilities of digital healthcare.

Together with healthcare professionals and partners around the world, we're working towards a future where people receive the right care in the right place. As our Senior Cloud Engineer, you'll help shape and modernise the cloud infrastructure behind these applications, building a reliable, scalable and future-proof foundation for millions of users worldwide.

Our applications have different histories, architectures and technical challenges. OMRON Connect, for example, runs on an AWS backend serving several million monthly active users. Parts of its infrastructure still carry legacy, including manual processes, scattered knowledge, inconsistent observability and release processes that make changes slower and riskier than they should be.

We're working towards a more consistent engineering foundation across our applications. Think Infrastructure as Code, cloud-native and event-driven architecture where it adds value, safe continuous deployment and observability by default. We're bringing more senior engineering expertise in-house to turn that ambition into concrete technical decisions, shared standards and a roadmap our teams can own. And that's where you come in 😉

Your role

You will work across our engineering teams, helping shape the cloud infrastructure behind our digital healthcare applications. Your focus will be on making the right architectural decisions, modernising existing platforms and enabling teams to independently build, maintain and improve their systems.

This isn't a greenfield architecture exercise. You will be improving live healthcare platforms while balancing technical improvements with product delivery, security, regulatory requirements and the realities of working with stakeholders across different countries, including the Netherlands and Japan.

What you will be doing, among others:

  • Own and evolve the Cloud & Backend roadmap, translating the engineering vision into clear priorities, trade-offs and next steps.

  • Drive cross-team architecture decisions to a close, making sure decisions are transparent, documented and followed through.

  • Establish shared technical standards and guardrails that allow teams to work autonomously without creating unnecessary dependencies.

  • Work hands-on with engineers on AWS and Terraform, reviewing designs and pull requests and challenging technical choices where needed.

  • Coach and pair with engineers, helping knowledge spread across teams and supporting the growth of seniority and ownership.

  • Work with product owners, QA, engineering leadership and colleagues in Japan to balance technical direction with product, regulatory, security and cost considerations.

  • Help move the platform towards automated infrastructure, safer deployments and stronger observability without relying on a big-bang rewrite.

The responsibilities outlined above reflect how we currently envision this role. As we continue to grow and evolve, the scope and focus of the position may naturally change, influenced by your own ideas and insights. The way we work is built around the belief that everyone's input matters. If you see opportunities to improve the way we do things, or believe a process could be designed differently to achieve a better outcome, we encourage you to bring those ideas forward. Discuss them with your teammates, challenge the status quo, and help shape how we move forward together.

Why Luscii?

Read more about working at Luscii / OMRON and how we work as a team. Together, we are working on a mission to create space for care. Freedom, autonomy and ownership are of great importance in this. You are responsible for your own results and work according to the principles of Holacracy. Luscii is part of OMRON DH; together we built for the long term. To work on making healthcare better.

Most important benefits

  • Salary: An annual maximum remuneration of approximately € 85.000 gross per year is estimated for this position (based on 32 hours per week – that’s full-time at Luscii), depending on the interviews, your experience, background and knowledge.

  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere in The Netherlands. We stay connected through monthly in-person team days called Assemblii.

  • Flexible setup: Create your own ideal workspace. Whatever works best for you - we’ve got you covered here. We do work from Mondays to Thursdays, as 32 hours per week is fulltime.

The ideal candidate…

… probably doesn't exist, but if you can tick most of the checkboxes below, please apply! We are looking for someone who enjoys taking ownership of complex technical challenges, makes pragmatic engineering decisions, and is excited about helping others succeed along the way.

You know when to step up, when to involve colleagues and when to move forward decisively. Working independently does not mean working in isolation for you. You feel at ease being both a self-starter and a committed team player, contributing to shared goals while taking responsibility for your own domain. You value open communication, transparency, and mutual trust.

  • You have at least 5+ years of experience in cloud/backend engineering and multiple years of hands-on experience with AWS and Terraform (Infrastructure as Code).

  • You are comfortable reviewing designs and pull requests. Experience with serverless and event-driven architectures is very valuable. All combined with experience in serverless AWS, Node.js/TypeScript tech stacks.

  • You actively coach, pair, review and share knowledge, with a focus on building ownership and seniority across the teams around you.

  • You understand what matters: the importance of making pragmatic technical choices within clear security, compliance and regulatory boundaries.

  • You are open to working in a Holacratic organization and curious about our way of organizing work, roles, and responsibilities;

  • English is our primary language for all internal communication at Luscii, so you're fluent in that language.

Interested? Apply now!

Would you like more information? Feel free to contact our recruiter Björn Bogerd via

What does the recruitment process look like?

We organise three interviews for each vacancy. It is an extensive process, but we want to ensure that there is a good fit in regards to a potential collaboration, our culture and our way of working. All interviews are conducted online and the entire procedure is planned in advance to keep momentum.

title: Lead Security Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Lead Security Engineer (m/w/d)

About Recare

As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management – technology-driven, patient-centered, and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals, and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with over 650 rehabilitation clinics and 25,000 nursing and homecare providers. With currently around 120 employees from a broad range of nations, we continue to grow – and we're now going far beyond our core business, aiming to eliminate bureaucracy and admin in hospitals with a whole portfolio of AI products.

What to expect as our Lead Security Engineer (m/w/d):

  • Purposeful work – your role will have a positive impact on patients, their families, and healthcare professionals.

  • Company culture – we believe in flat hierarchies that promote high performance and strong team dynamics. We foster an environment characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. Together, we strive for our goals – and expect the same from you.

  • Flexibility – want to pick up your child from daycare? Like to exercise during lunch? We'll support you. We are a remote-friendly company offering flexible working hours. Workations are also possible by arrangement.

  • Edenred card – which you can use according to your needs.

  • Extra vacation day – so you can celebrate your birthday with your loved ones, you'll have the day off.

In this role, you can make an impact and grow with us as Lead Security Engineer (m/w/d):

You'll be our first dedicated security engineer: a senior IC with no team at the start. You join as Deputy CISO, report to our Director of Technology (currently acting CISO), and build security engineering from scratch. The baseline is already in place – ISO 27001, C5 Type II, regular penetration tests, and encryption in the product. AI is adding new surfaces: voice documentation, document generation, and agentic workflows. You build and own the security program, the tooling, and the security story we tell customers.

  • Vulnerability management – scanners and dependency updates across repos, plus the process that gets findings closed.

  • Partner to Platform – review security-sensitive infrastructure decisions and explore options like customer-managed keys or HSMs. Platform still owns architecture.

  • Certifications, technical side – control design and assessments for our ISO 27001 and C5 setup, the security case for a potential upcoming Class IIa medical device (MDR), and pentest scoping and follow-up, with regulation like the EU Cyber Resilience Act on the horizon. This is roughly a quarter to a third of the role, and we say it openly: for the right person in healthcare security, it's a draw, not a chore.

  • Customer security – reusable docs, evidence, and AI-assisted questionnaires, so the tenth enterprise deal costs a fraction of the first. You join the call when a hospital CISO asks something new about our AI architecture.

  • Incident response – process, runbooks, and escalation, and you lead when it's real. We're too small for a SOC, so you design on-call that fits a company our size. Product incidents and platform bugs have their own owners in engineering.

  • Company-wide security – watch the threat landscape, turn this week's supply-chain mess into concrete actions, and set the baselines IT applies to devices and accounts.

How we work:

  • AI-native – our engineers use coding agents every day. Security should too: scanning, evidence, questionnaires.

  • AI is also our attack surface – agent sandboxing, prompt injection, voice data, computer-use automation inside hospitals. We deal with security questions most companies will only meet in a few years.

  • Human-in-the-loop by default – this is healthcare: AI proposes, people stay in control.

  • Ship and observe – we ship continuously and debug from telemetry, including in the open when that's the fastest path.


Here's how we picture you as our Lead Security Engineer (m/w/d):

  • You're a hands-on security engineer with 6+ years across software and security engineering, and you can point to a security program (or a big part of one) you've owned.

  • You've been the technical counterpart through at least one ISO 27001, C5, or SOC 2 certification cycle: you've designed controls, faced an auditor, and written the technical side of a Statement of Applicability. This is a hard requirement.

  • You've run vulnerability management somewhere real: scanners, dependency bots, triage, and the follow-through that gets things fixed.

  • You follow the security scene closely (podcasts, advisories, incident write-ups) and usually have an opinion on this week's incident before it reaches the news.

  • You're genuinely curious about AI security – both securing AI systems (agents, sandboxing, data flows) and using AI tooling to work at leverage.

  • You can talk to engineers, auditors, and hospital security teams in English without a slide deck translating for you.

Nice to have:

  • German language skills, since our customers and the C5 world are German-speaking.

  • Experience in healthcare or another regulated domain.

  • Offensive security experience.

  • Security certifications such as OSCP, CISSP, or similar.

title: Software TPM (B2B2C)
description:
We're looking for a Technical Program Manager with strong Product thinking to drive inline's Table Management System (TMS) and Food Ordering (FO) products, together with our global partner integrations.
The right person in this role will play a pivotal role in planning, building, and scaling the products that power restaurants' front-of-house operations — reservations, table management, queuing, deposits & payments, and food ordering — while connecting inline to a growing ecosystem of global partners such as booking platforms, POS systems, membership systems, malls, and regional restaurant groups. The key to this role is orchestrating complex, multi-stakeholder programs that serve merchants, patrons, and partners at once, and turning deep F&B domain knowledge into product decisions that improve merchant operations and patron experiences across markets.
Responsibilities

Strategy & Prioritization

Partner closely with the stakeholders and UX design team to shape and translate product vision into executable roadmaps for the TMS and FO product lines.

Conduct market research and competitive analysis across the F&B tech landscape (reservation platforms, POS ecosystems, food ordering, channel managers) to provide product recommendations.

Evaluate product and integration opportunities by balancing merchant value, patron experience, partner impact, engineering effort, and operational complexity.

Continuously monitor product and partner metrics (e.g. partner-driven bookings, seated conversion, no-show rate) and provide insights to refine priorities and roadmap execution.

Program Management

Lead cross-functional programs from planning through execution across the TMS and FO product surfaces, including different interfaces for both restaurants and patrons, and premium add-on features.

Coordinate closely with Engineering, Design, QA, CSM/BD, Marketing, Operations, and other stakeholders to align priorities and execution.

Manage Product Backlog, Release Planning, Sprint Planning, and Scrum execution.

Identify project risks, resolve blockers proactively, and drive teams toward successful delivery, including launch readiness such as internal playbooks and training.

Global Partner Integration

Own the end-to-end partner integration lifecycle: scoping and scenario design, API documentation and testing setup, kickoff, development support, E2E testing, launch, and post-launch operations.

Manage integrations across partner types — booking platforms, POS systems, membership systems, malls and hospitality groups, and regional restaurant groups.

Serve as the primary technical counterpart for global partners across regions and time zones, running kickoff meetings, joint testing, and ongoing technical communication.

Define integration scenarios, acceptance criteria, and success metrics; keep integration projects transparent and on track for internal and external stakeholders.

Stakeholder Management & F&B Insights

Manage intensive, ongoing communication across internal stakeholders (leadership, Engineering, Design, QA, Go to Market teams with daily interaction, Marketing) and external stakeholders (partners and key merchant accounts) with often-competing priorities.

Develop a deep understanding of restaurant front-of-house operations: reservations as inventory management and capacity planning, reservations as a key patron touchpoint, table management, queuing, no-show and revenue assurance/deposit policies, and online food ordering workflows — and represent the merchant's voices in product decisions.

Translate merchant and partner feedback into clear pain point statements and roadmap inputs.

Support multinational delivery with customers in seven highly differentiated markets, including localization and market-specific requirements across regions such as TW, HK, JP, SEA, and ANZ.

 

Requirements

Required

5+ years of Technical Product Management, Technical Program Management, or related experience.

Experience building B2B or B2B2C SaaS software ; vertical SaaS for F&B, restaurants, or hospitality is a strong plus.

Deep F&B industry knowledge, especially restaurant front-of-house operations: reservation and table management, queuing, deposits/no-show handling, POS, or food ordering.

Hands-on experience with adding new third-party integrations And expanding upon existing third-party Integrations — REST APIs, Webhooks, API key/staging environment management, data licensing compliance automation, and end-to-end testing with external partner engineering teams.

Excellent stakeholder management skills, with a track record of driving alignment across executives, cross-functional teams, and external partners.

Ability to work closely with Engineering to evaluate technical feasibility, development effort, and resource planning.

Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.

Excellent cross-functional communication and program management skills; able to work in English with global partners.

 

Preferred

Experience working directly with engineers designers in one or more of the following areas is highly preferred:

Online payment systems, including payment gateways (e.g. Stripe, TapPay), digital wallets (Apple Pay, AliPay, WeChat Pay), deposits/prepayment flows, or subscription billing.

Omnichannel messaging or Omnichannel CRM systems (e.g. Intercom, Twilio Flex, Zendesk, etc)

Global Distribution Systems (GDS) used by airlines or hotels to create and manage priced booking inventory that is published to OTA services (e.g. Amadeus, Travelport, Sabre, or Siteminder, Opera, Cendyn, Shiji, etc)

Booking channel integrations, such as Reserve with Google, channel managers, or OTA/booking platform ecosystems.

POS or hospitality tech ecosystems, including KDS, kiosk, or in-store hardware-adjacent products.

Multi-market product delivery, including multi-language support and market-specific compliance or operational requirements.

Experience working with Product Analytics and data-driven prioritization.

title: Investment Portfolio Analysis Expert, hybrid, Senior Associate
description:
Who we are looking for

An open-minded person who would like to contribute to expansion of Alpha footprint in Poland. Someone who values great work atmosphere, being close to the managers, achieving goals and resolving problems as a group within one big global Alpha team. Someone who already has chosen finances as his life’s career path and wants to excellence his knowledge. Surrounding great professionals will help grow both in personal and professional development.

What is Alpha platform

State Street Alpha is the first front-to-back asset servicing platform from a single provider for institutional and wealth management firms.

Alpha brings together our clients’ choice of real-time data and asset intelligence across the investment lifecycle to help them make better decisions and deliver growth for their clients.

With built-in flexibility and scalability, Alpha lets clients manage any assets in any market and streamline their day-to-day processes — helping to facilitate innovation, better inform investment decisions, optimize returns and streamline business operations.

Your new role

As an Investment Portfolio Analysis Expert you will be responsible for:

Performing, reviewing and coordinating daily checks on file deliverables to the clients and investigating discrepancies

Taking ownership of the issues resolution, engaging others to gain consensus

Monitoring daily processes and internal/external communication, flagging any issues during group discussions or to the manager, suggesting improvements, taking ownership over resolution process

Developing and maintaining relationships with client´s representatives, and internal/external stakeholders to help aid successful delivery of service

Working together with global team members to discuss strategic initiatives and close out issues

Maintaining effective communication with colleagues and the managers

Adhering to internal procedures and best practices at all times

Offering guidance and support to the less experienced members of the team

Actively working with other team members to build team spirit to be able to grow as a group

Leading initiatives to strengthen team collaboration and engagement, supporting a culture of continuous improvement.

What we value 

Skills and competencies:

Critical thinking, problem solving, and decision-making skills

Good client service skills; ability to interact and communicate with various level business partners

Good time management, organizational and team working skills

Adaptability, high level of self-motivation and ability to show initiative is an asset

Good command of English language

Proactive mindset and "can do" attitude is a plus

Willingness to learn and discover the industry

Education & Preferred Qualifications:

3+ years of financial services industry experience: experience in Custody, Middle Office, Fund Administration functions is an asset

Customer service or professional experience from a different area than above-listed is acceptable

Working knowledge of MS Excel

Work requirements:

Hybrid role model: required at least 3 days from the office per week

Minimum Salary:​
zł87,000 Annual

The minimum salary quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate ultimately works outside of this primary location, the applicable minimum salary may differ.​

Salary will be determined based on factors such as the position, type of work performed, individual skills, job description, working hours, diligence, initiative, self-management, length of employment, availability, and the quantity and quality of work delivered, as well as other objective and non-discriminatory criteria relevant to State Street employees.​

In addition to salary, employees are eligible to be considered for discretionary annual performance-based awards.​

​

We Offer:​

Permanent contract from day one​

Additional holidays (Birthday Day Off, 3rd and 5th year anniversary Day Off)​

Gold Medical Package for employees and their families (partner and children)​

Premium life insurance package and private pension plan​

Wide range of soft skills training, technical workshops, language classes and development programs​

Opportunities to volunteer your time to company-driven initiatives, employee networks or organizations of your choice​

Variety of well-being programs​

Additional benefits available depending on the seniority of the role

About State Street

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. title: Global PMO Lead
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Global PMO Lead based in Spain.

The Global PMO Lead will establish and lead a global Program Management Office, ensuring that the organisation’s most important cross-functional initiatives are delivered effectively across regions and business units. This hands-on leadership role combines direct ownership of complex strategic programs with the development of a scalable, practical PMO operating model. You will work closely with senior executives and functional leaders to translate business priorities into clear execution plans, improve visibility, and address risks before they affect delivery. You will also build and develop a team of program managers who act as trusted execution partners rather than administrative coordinators. In a fast-growing, international environment, you will bring structure to ambiguity while keeping processes lightweight and adaptable. Your work will directly strengthen accountability, resource allocation, and the organisation’s ability to deliver its highest-impact priorities.

Accountabilities

Lead high-priority, cross-functional programs from ambiguous initial requirements through planning, coordination, and successful delivery.

Translate strategic priorities into actionable plans with clear sponsors, owners, milestones, dependencies, timelines, and success criteria.

Partner with senior leadership to identify and prioritise a focused portfolio of high-impact initiatives.

Provide executive teams with a consolidated, accurate overview of program progress, milestones, risks, resource constraints, and decisions required.

Identify and address blockers, unclear ownership, handoff issues, and cross-functional dependencies, escalating risks when necessary.

Establish a lightweight, globally consistent PMO operating model covering prioritisation, planning, execution, reporting, and escalation.

Adapt processes to different regional and functional needs while building on existing weekly, monthly, and quarterly operating rhythms.

Coordinate competing priorities and resource constraints across the program portfolio, helping leaders make informed trade-offs.

Recruit, manage, and develop a team of program managers, ensuring every major initiative has clear execution ownership.

Build a service-oriented PMO that supports functional and regional leaders without becoming an additional approval layer or decision-making bottleneck.

Improve delivery predictability while reducing duplicated work and unnecessary coordination overhead.

Requirements:

Proven experience personally leading multiple high-priority, cross-functional initiatives from ambiguous requirements through successful delivery.

Experience building, scaling, or significantly improving a PMO or enterprise program management function.

Background managing programs across multiple countries, business units, or distributed organisations.

Demonstrated ability to work directly with C-level executives and functional leaders to establish priorities, resolve conflicts, and drive execution without relying on direct authority.

Experience managing competing initiatives, portfolio-level priorities, and limited resources.

Previous experience managing, coaching, and developing program managers or comparable cross-functional execution teams.

Strong capabilities in program tracking, executive reporting, accountability frameworks, and delivery performance improvement.

Ability to operate effectively in fast-growing organisations with evolving structures, shifting priorities, and significant ambiguity.

Comfortable moving between strategic portfolio oversight and hands-on program execution.

Nice to have: Experience in hardware, manufacturing, defence, government technology, or other complex delivery environments.

Nice to have: A professional services background or experience working in large, complex enterprises with substantial cross-functional dependencies.

Benefits:

Fully remote working arrangement.

Full-time employment.

Opportunity to build and lead a global PMO function with direct exposure to senior executives and strategic initiatives.

International working environment spanning multiple regions and business units.

title: Senior AI Engineer - VLA Foundation Model
description:
RIVR, part of Amazon is a robotics company pioneering Physical AI through real-world doorstep delivery. Founded in 2024 as an ETH Zurich spin-off, RIVR developed wheeled-legged robots designed to operate in complex, unstructured environments such as stairs, gates, doors, and uneven urban terrain. We believe that achieving general physical intelligence requires solving real customer problems in the real world, where robots can learn from rich operational data at scale.

Following our acquisition by Amazon in March 2026, we are continuing this mission with greater reach and speed. By combining custom robot hardware, onboard autonomy, and cloud-based coordination, RIVR, part of Amazon is building the next generation of safe, reliable autonomous robots for last-mile delivery


Job Description
 
Our fleet of delivery robots operates globally today, generating vast amounts of robotic real-world data. By utilizing state-of-the-art Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, large-scale generalist models (like Transformers), generative AI, and similar methods, we can leverage this pool of data to significantly enhance its autonomy, navigation, and manipulation skills. In this role, you will develop multi-modal models that enable robots to autonomously generate actions from demonstrations, real-time sensor data, and natural language commands. We are seeking an expert in VLA models, imitation learning, and generative AI techniques with a deep knowledge of supervised, and self-supervised learning algorithms. If you are passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI we invite you to join us in shaping the future of intelligent robotics.
 
 

What you’ll be doing
  • Develop and implement cutting-edge Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, generalist robot transformers, and imitation learning algorithms (e.g., diffusion policies) to enable robots to autonomously execute complex tasks.
  • Design, test, and refine your algorithms to meet the demands of complex real-world autonomy and navigation tasks, with a focus on spatial reasoning and generalization.
  • Streamline the data collection and training workflow to efficiently expand model capabilities with new tasks and data sources.
  • Collaborate with the reinforcement learning team to innovate methods that leverage both simulated and real-world data.
  • Optimize and distill networks for real-time deployment on the edge (e.g. Nvidia Jetson Thor).
  • Build, lead and mentor an exceptional team of software engineers.
  • Provide expert guidance to product managers and executives for strategic decision-making.
  • Create and maintain documentation, guidelines, and best practices to streamline knowledge sharing.

    • What you must have
  • Master’s degree or higher in a relevant field such as Engineering, Robotics, or Machine Learning.
  • A minimum of three years of industry or research experience, with PhD experience applicable.
  • Strong deep learning fundamentals including supervised learning, self-supervised learning, Transformer-based architectures, policy optimization algorithms, imitation learning, and generative AI techniques (including Diffusion Models).
  • Proven experience in developing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models or large-scale generalist robot models (e.g., RT-2, Octo, etc.).
  • Strong background in robotics including autonomy, navigation.
  • Experience with deploying artificial neural networks on hardware platforms.
  • Ability to prototype algorithms and train deep neural networks in Python (Pytorch)

    • Get some bonus points
  • PhD degree in Robotics, Engineering, Computer Science, Machine Learning or a similar discipline, or an equivalent amount of research experience.
  • Publications at top-tier conferences.
  • Experience in managing a software team.
  • Ability to write production-level code in modern C++
    • RIVR, part of Amazon is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that values every perspective. If you’re passionate about driving innovation in robotics and creating meaningful impact, we encourage you to apply and bring your unique self to our team.
     
    We believe the best work is done when collaborating and therefore require in-person presence in our office locations.

title: Senior Technical Sales Manager - AI-Driven Software Engineering
description:
About CREATEQ

CREATEQ is a Swiss software engineering company with more than 30 years of experience in delivering custom software solutions and modernizing complex legacy systems. We work with leading international companies across industries such as banking and fintech, insurance, aviation and transportation, telecommunications, and energy.

We design, build, and run high-quality software solutions, combining strong engineering expertise, modern technologies, AI-enabled approaches, and proven delivery practices. Our teams work across Java, .NET, PHP, mobile, and web development, helping clients modernize their technology landscapes, improve their software capabilities, and build solutions that are reliable, scalable, and ready for the future.

We are fully dedicated to long-term partnerships, working as one organization with our customers and taking ownership from the first idea through to reliable execution and smooth operation. With nearshore delivery centers across Europe, we bring together experienced engineering and delivery teams who combine technical excellence, business understanding, and a strong sense of ownership.

People, engineering excellence, and strong client relationships are at the heart of what we do.

 

The opportunity

We are looking for an experienced, entrepreneurial Senior Technical Sales Manager to drive new business for CREATEQ with full revenue responsibility. In this role, you will win new clients, shape their entry into AI-driven software engineering, and turn it into long-term engineering engagements delivered by our teams.

Many companies still develop software the traditional way, mostly on Java and .NET. They want to benefit from AI-driven development but lack the know-how, processes, and capacity to do so. This is where you come in: you understand the client's starting point, develop the right approach together with them – from assessment and proof of concept to dedicated nearshore teams – and close the deal.

You will work closely with management, Business Development, and our engineering leads, and you will be the face of CREATEQ to CIOs, CTOs, and Heads of Engineering in Switzerland [and the DACH region].

 

What you'll do

  • Build and close your own pipeline with mid-sized and large companies in Switzerland [and the DACH region].
  • Assess clients' development processes, technology stacks, and AI maturity, and run workshops with engineering teams, IT leadership, and executive management.
  • Develop solution concepts and proposals – from assessment and proof of concept to dedicated nearshore engineering teams.
  • Lead commercial negotiations through to contract signature.
  • Grow existing client relationships and secure follow-on business.
  • Work closely with our engineering leads on team set-up, project kick-off, and quality assurance.
  • Track pipeline, order intake, and revenue against agreed targets and report on progress to management.

 

What we're looking for

This is a senior role with clear revenue responsibility. We are looking for someone who has successfully sold IT services before, brings a strong network in the Swiss market, and is equally credible in conversations with developers and with executive management.

Requirements

  • At least 8 years of experience selling IT services, software engineering, or nearshore/offshore capacity, including several years with personal revenue responsibility.
  • A proven track record in acquiring new clients and closing multi-year service engagements.
  • A strong network among CIOs, CTOs, and Heads of Engineering in the Swiss market.
  • A technical background (computer science, business informatics, or equivalent practical experience) with a solid understanding of Java and/or .NET environments and modern engineering practices (CI/CD, automated testing, DevOps).
  • A solid understanding of AI-driven software development (AI coding assistants, agentic development tools) and a realistic view of its benefits and limitations.
  • An entrepreneurial, closing-oriented mindset and the ability to work independently.
  • Native/Fluent German and excellent written and spoken English.
  • Swiss or EU citizenship, or a valid Swiss work permit.

Benefits

  • A key role with direct impact on CREATEQ's growth.
  • An offering that is high on clients' agendas: AI-driven software engineering, delivered by experienced engineering teams.
  • A compensation package with a fixed salary and a performance-based component.
  • Direct collaboration with management and short decision paths.
  • Freedom to shape the role, bring your ideas, and make a visible impact.
  • A long-term perspective in an international software engineering company with a strong presence in the European market.

title: Senior Security Operations Engineer
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a member of our Security Operations Team, you will collaborate with a global team of engineers to monitor and respond to security events, lead security incidents as Incident Commander, and lead digital forensic investigations in support of Employee Relations, Legal, Compliance, or Information Security cases.

Although you will be focused on security incident response, you will also have the opportunity to create and maintain runbooks, and automated workflows, and assist in process refinement and implementation. You will collaborate with a diverse team of engineers, and key stakeholders on security initiatives across the company. Above all, your focus is bringing Security expertise to the table in a collaborative, humble, and practical manner.

Location: This role is open to candidates residing in the UK

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will: 

  • Monitor security events and provide technical analysis on alerts
  • Lead information security incidents and employee insider investigations by developing the incident response strategy, lead the execution through incident closure, while providing incident updates to key stakeholders throughout the incident
  • Deliver security guidance clearly and concisely for incident response and insider threat initiatives
  • Coordinate the building of services, capabilities, integrations, and implementations of technologies to support security operations, incident response, and insider threat
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Participate in our on-call rota covering weekends

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years of experience in Security Incident Response
  • Ability to communicate investigative findings and strategies to technical staff, executive leadership, and legal
  • Ability to build scripts or tools to support Samsara's investigation processes, with proficiency in Python
  • Mentor and train security operation engineers on data collection, analysis, and reporting technical analysis
  • Practical experience acting as a lead during security incident response, including monitoring and triaging alerts, and coordinating across teams
  • Understanding of analysis and forensics techniques on macOS, Windows, and Linux
  • Experience utilizing SIEM tools to perform log reviews
  • Experience in cloud architecture and security (AWS, GCP) and cloud-based services
  • Participation in an on-call rotation, with the potential to work outside standard business hours, including late evenings, when responding to high-severity incidents as part of our global incident response team.
  • This role will be part of our EMEA so your hours will be aligned to the UK. As an operational time you may be expected to work flexible hours around this to support the load of the team

An ideal candidate also has:

  • 2+ years of experience working on insider threat initiatives or employee investigations
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field - or relevant industry experience
  • GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH) or similar Certification
  • Familiarity with common security frameworks and standards, including NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO 27001, FedRAMP

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

description:
About the role 

 

At Apaleo, we're building the open, API-first property management platform for hospitality. With integrations across hundreds of apps through the Apaleo Store, and the first AI agent marketplace for hospitality in our Agent Hub, we simplify operations, elevate the guest journey and drive revenue growth for our customers. 

We're looking for a senior Product Manager to ownin our AI product domain. You'll turn our AI capabilities into coherent, commercially viable products that solve real operational problems for hoteliers. Your goal is to help hotels move towards genuinely autonomous operations, not to ship isolated automations or AI assistants. 

This is not a backlog role. You'll take an ambiguous opportunity, find the right customer problems, define the proposition, build it with Engineering, bring it to market and drive adoption. You'll also play a central role in turning our AI capabilities into a meaningful and growing source of revenue. 

This is a senior individual contributor role with real autonomy. You won't receive a roadmap and execute it. You'll shape it along our vision, using customer insight, data and sound reasoning. You'll work closely with Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing and Customer Success, and in close collaboration with our other value stream teams.  

 

What you'll be up to 

  • Productising and commercialising our AI capabilities. Define the proposition, target customers and use cases, and shape packaging and launch with commercial teams. 
  • Building the foundations for AI across our ecosystem. Shape how our AI capabilities understand each hotel's context and work reliably with Apaleo and connected systems across operational areas. 
  • Productising hospitality knowledge. Turn hospitality expertise and operational processes into scalable product experiences, with appropriate human oversight. 
  • Driving autonomy and measurable value. Think in complete outcomes, such as staff hours saved and manual work removed. Show hoteliers tangible ROI. 
  • Driving adoption. Run discovery, shape onboarding and usability, measure adoption and improve from real-world feedback. 
  • Keeping AI products reliable and viable. Define good agent performance, understand cost and latency, set up evaluation and monitoring with Engineering, and trade off autonomy, reliability, human intervention and cost. 
  • Owning strategy, roadmap and delivery in your scope, with clear specs, a definition of done and impact analysis. 
  • Working with Engineering on trade-offs, dependencies, quality and our API-first AI-first architecture. 
  • Balancing ambition with reality. Weigh the roadmap against operational requests, bugs and technical debt, and say no to good ideas that aren't great ones. 
  • Spotting dependencies early with Hotel Operations and other engineering teams, since our AI capabilities build on the core platform. 
  • Using AI in your own PM work and championing AI-assisted engineering.  

 

What you'll bring 

  • 6+ years as a Product Manager, owning products from discovery through launch and adoption with limited day-to-day direction. 
  • Proven zero-to-one experience. You've taken a new B2B product, not a feature, from an ambiguous problem to paying customers, driving discovery, validation, definition, prioritisation and launch. 
  • Ownership after launch. You've owned a revenue, adoption or retention number and can tell us what moved and what you killed, pivoted or repriced. 
  • Commercial thinking. You've defined propositions, packaging and pricing, validated willingness to pay and worked with Sales, Marketing and Customer Success on go-to-market. 
  • Systems and process thinking. You break processes into steps, decisions and handoffs, and understand how systems with different data models and sources of truth affect the reliability of agents. 
  • Meaningful AI product experience. You've built and launched AI-powered products or capabilities used by real customers, understand what makes a product agentic, and can discuss context, tools, latency, cost and evaluation, with a view on human-in-the-loop design. 
  • Customer centricity and product judgement. You turn interview patterns into opportunities, make tough trade-offs and prioritise ruthlessly. 
  • Platform thinking. You weigh customer needs against reusable capabilities, API consistency and long-term platform evolution. 
  • Stakeholder alignment. You align Engineering, commercial teams and peers, manage cross-team dependencies and communicate trade-offs with confidence. 
  • Autonomy and adaptability. You take ownership, raise risks early and make progress through ambiguity. 

 

Strongly preferred 

  • Agentic AI products in production. You've taken an agentic AI product beyond prototype to paying customers, and dealt with reliability, permissions, exceptions, human intervention and evaluation. This is different from AI-powered features such as chatbots, summarisation or copilots. 

 

Nice to have 

  • Hospitality technology or hotel operations experience. 
  • Experience with PMS, RMS, CRS, channel managers, OTAs or hospitality distribution. 
  • Experience in B2B SaaS platforms, ecosystems or integration-heavy products. 
  • Experience with AI governance, permissions, identity, orchestration or enterprise AI adoption. 
  • Experience in a fast-moving startup or scale-up. 
  • Comfort with AI-assisted engineering processes. 

 

Don't tick every box? Hospitality experience is an advantage, not a prerequisite. A strong zero-to-one B2B product builder from another domain, with real AI product experience and a commercial mindset, can be a better fit than a hospitality specialist without them. We'd still love to hear from you. 

 

Who you are 

  • You take high ownership. You answer for product outcomes, not just delivery commitments. 
  • You're strategic and hands-on. You can set a product vision and still get into customer discovery, operational processes and detailed product decisions. 
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. You make progress when the problem or the solution isn't fully defined. 
  • You think commercially. You ask what customers will buy and why, not just what Engineering can build. 
  • You're customer obsessed. You understand real operational pain and test your assumptions with customers. 
  • You're technically curious. You know enough about AI and agentic systems to hold meaningful discussions with engineers and make informed product decisions. 
  • You measure what matters. You judge success by customer outcomes, adoption and commercial impact, not features shipped. 

 

What we offer 

Culture and growth 

  • A diverse and international team. Work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities, bringing unique perspectives and experiences to shape the future of hospitality tech. 
  • Growth and development. You'll benefit from 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget and plenty of chances to take on more responsibility. 
  • Autonomy and ownership. Great ideas can come from anywhere. We empower you to take responsibility, make decisions and contribute directly, in an environment built on trust and transparency. 
  • Competitive and fair compensation. Our salaries are competitive and guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. 

 

Perks and lifestyle 

  • Flexible and remote work options. We focus on results, not clocking hours. Work from home, the office or in a hybrid setup. 
  • Free public transport. Travel across Germany with a fully covered Deutschland Ticket. 
  • Paid time off. 30 days of vacation to fully disconnect, recharge and return inspired. 
  • Health and wellbeing. Access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios and wellness options through our EGYM Wellpass membership. 

 

Joining Apaleo 

How you make an impact joining Apaleo: Joining Apaleo is more than taking on a role. It's about driving real change in the hospitality industry. Your contributions will directly shape our innovative platform, influence company-wide decisions and help redefine the future of hospitality tech. 

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive and welcoming workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data will be handled with the utmost care and in compliance with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations. We celebrate differences and believe that diversity enriches our team and drives innovation.

This Role

France's solution partner ecosystem is an important lever for Dust's growth. As Partner Account Manager, Solution Partners (France), you'll own activation and follow-through for assigned new and existing Tier 1 solution partners that are not yet strategic. You'll turn those relationships into qualified opportunities and repeatable commercial motions, working closely with Dust's Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Partnerships teams.

This is a hands-on, commercially accountable role. You'll help assigned partners identify the right customer problems, shape clear joint propositions, and move opportunities forward. You'll enable partner teams to explain Dust and support customers effectively, drawing on Dust's technical and delivery teams where needed. Your focus is activation and follow-through for your assigned French solution partner portfolio, in coordination with colleagues who own strategic partner relationships and broader ecosystem programs.

Key Responsibilities

Grow and activate the partner portfolio

  • Own activation and follow-through for assigned new and existing Tier 1 solution partners in France that are not yet strategic, including digital transformation and AI consultancies, systems integrators, and implementation partners

  • Agree on focused joint plans with each priority partner, including target accounts, customer problems, sellable offers, measurable outcomes, owners, and next steps

  • Identify promising new solution partner relationships and qualify them on customer access, strategic fit, delivery capability, and willingness to invest in a joint motion

  • Help partners turn their existing expertise and customer relationships into a clear path to working with Dust

Generate and progress partner-led opportunities

  • Work with partners and Dust Account Executives to identify, qualify, and advance partner-sourced and partner-influenced opportunities

  • Map stakeholders and account entry points, clarify the partner's role, and coordinate next steps across the customer, partner, and Dust teams

  • Support deal strategy, value articulation, and partner participation in sales cycles, escalating product, commercial, or delivery questions to the right teams

  • Maintain a reliable view of partner pipeline, deal progress, risks, and expected contribution in Dust's CRM and reporting processes

Enable partners to sell and support Dust

  • Run practical partner onboarding and enablement so partner teams can explain Dust, identify relevant use cases, and participate confidently in customer conversations

  • Coordinate product, sales, and deployment guidance with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Partner Delivery; help partners become increasingly self-sufficient without taking on delivery ownership

  • Share relevant customer stories, use cases, and sales materials, and identify gaps in the enablement partners need to move opportunities forward

  • Help partners understand how Dust connects to customer systems and supports teams using multiple AI models and agents

Build a repeatable solution partner motion

  • Establish a consistent operating rhythm with partners, including pipeline reviews, business reviews, action tracking, and timely escalation of blockers

  • Monitor partner activation, qualified pipeline, opportunity progression, closed revenue, and partner readiness; use the evidence to focus time and investment

  • Identify patterns in successful partner-led deals and feed practical recommendations into the broader Partnerships and GTM teams

  • Surface customer and partner feedback from the French market to inform positioning, offers, enablement, and go-to-market priorities

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in partnerships, channel sales, business development, or commercial account management in B2B SaaS or a related technology business

  • A track record of creating measurable commercial outcomes through partners, such as qualified pipeline, co-sell opportunities, partner activation, or revenue

  • Strong understanding of the French B2B partner ecosystem, including consultancies, systems integrators, and implementation partners, with the ability to qualify them on customer access and fit

  • Fluent French and professional English, with the ability to lead partner and customer conversations in both languages

  • Commercial judgment and operating discipline: you can prioritize a partner portfolio, build actionable joint plans, manage a pipeline, and maintain clear follow-through

  • Confidence coordinating multi-party sales opportunities and aligning external partners with internal sales and technical teams

  • Strong communication and enablement skills: you can make a technical product understandable and help others present its value credibly

  • A self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity, takes ownership, raises risks early, and builds practical processes as the motion develops

  • Curiosity about AI and a willingness to use agents and AI tools to improve how you work

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with digital transformation agencies, AI consultancies, regional systems integrators, or implementation partners

  • Experience activating solution partners and progressing partner-sourced or partner-influenced opportunities in France

  • Familiarity with AI agents, enterprise software, SaaS integrations, or technology-enabled consulting and delivery

  • Existing relationships with relevant French solution partner firms

What Makes This Role Unique

  • Direct commercial impact: Your work will contribute to qualified pipeline, partner-led opportunities, and revenue in France

  • A focused growth mandate: Activate assigned new and existing French Tier 1 solution partners that are not yet strategic, with clear prioritization and commercial accountability

  • Cross-functional ownership: Connect partners with the right Dust commercial, technical, and delivery teams to make joint opportunities actionable

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.
